swahili: Tumia kidirisha cha kuchapisha cha kivinjari kuhifadhi nakala ya mfano.

english: Enter the confirmation code sent to the phone number or email address on your account. Each code works once only.
swahili: Andika namba ya uthibitisho inayotumwa kwenye namba ya simu au barua pepe iliyo kwenye akaunti yako. Kila namba hutumika mara moja tu.

english: This entry does not exist. Choose a way into the rental site.
swahili: Lango hili halipo. Chagua njia ya kuingia kwenye ukurasa wa upangishaji.

english: Please check the fields marked below.
swahili: Tafadhali angalia sehemu zilizowekwa alama hapa chini.

english: This request carries an idempotency key, so retrying cannot create a second payment.
swahili: Ombi hili lina namba ya kuzuia kurudia, hivyo kujaribu tena hakuwezi kuunda malipo ya pili.

english: The request did not finish in time. Its status is unconfirmed — it is neither confirmed nor failed.
swahili: Ombi halikukamilika kwa wakati. Hali yake haijathibitishwa — si uthibitisho wa mafanikio wala kushindwa.
Mawazo ya muunganisho na vikwazo vya jukwaa

english: No business database, tax rule, payment flow, licence decision or authoritative audit log exists in this layer. Every business value on screen comes from the integration layer.
swahili: Hakuna hifadhidata ya biashara, kanuni ya kodi, mtiririko wa malipo, uamuzi wa leseni au kumbukumbu ya ukaguzi yenye mamlaka katika safu hii. Kila thamani ya biashara inayotokea kwenye skrini inatoka kwenye safu ya muunganisho.

english: The delivery package is written in English for the backend team.
swahili: Kifurushi cha uwasilishaji kimeandikwa kwa Kiingereza kwa timu ya backend.

english: What the backend team needs to implement against, and what is still simulated.
swahili: Kinachohitajika kwa timu ya backend kutekeleza, na kile ambacho bado ni cha mfano.
Muundo unaopendekezwa wa maombi na majibu

english: The full address is not shown to the public. Only the Mtaa officer and you can see it.
swahili: Anwani kamili haionyeshwi kwa umma. Inaonekana kwa afisa wa Mtaa na kwako pekee.

english: If your units are already registered, go straight to Pangisha.
swahili: Kama uniti zako zimeshasajiliwa, nenda moja kwa moja kwenye Pangisha.

english: When a tenant is recorded, you pick the unit name instead of typing the house again. One name, one tenant.
swahili: Mpangaji anaporekodiwa, unachagua jina la uniti badala ya kuandika nyumba upya. Jina moja, mpangaji mmoja.

english: Each unit now has a verification case ({cases}). Upload ownership evidence for each unit; an officer decides. A unit cannot carry a lease or a Stage 2 payment until it is verified.
swahili: Kila uniti sasa lina kesi ya uhakiki ({cases}). Pakia hati ya umiliki kwa kila uniti; afisa ndiye anaamua. Uniti haliwezi kuwa na mkataba wala malipo ya Hatua 2 kabla ya kuthibitishwa.

english: Each unit has its own number. You use these when you rent a unit out.
swahili: Kila uniti lina namba yake. Hizi ndizo utakazotumia unapopangisha.

english: Could not load the fictional local council. Reload before registering test data.
swahili: Imeshindwa kupakia halmashauri ya mfano. Pakia upya kabla ya kusajili data ya majaribio.

english: Local simulation: create the fictional council on the simulation page first. Pilot councils are not available in local data.
swahili: Majaribio ya ndani: kwanza unda halmashauri ya mfano kwenye ukurasa wa majaribio. Halmashauri za majaribio halisi hazipatikani kwenye data ya ndani.

english: A phone number is required, for example 0712345678.
Enter your name, the street name and the house number.
swahili: Jaza jina lako, jina la mtaa na namba ya nyumba.

english: Two units cannot have the same name. Change one of them.
swahili: Uniti mbili haziwezi kuwa na jina moja. Badilisha moja.

english: Every unit needs a name. Use a name you recognise.
swahili: Kila uniti linahitaji jina. Tumia jina unalolitambua.

english: One form is enough: you, the house and every unit you own. Each unit gets its own reference number.
swahili: Fomu moja inatosha: wewe, nyumba na uniti zote ulizonazo. Kila uniti linapata namba yake ya kumbukumbu.

english: Optional. If you give it, we use it to send you updates.
swahili: Si lazima. Ukiitoa, tutaitumia kukutumia taarifa.

english: The street the house is on
How many units do you have?
Each unit gets its own reference number. Up to 20 in one registration.
swahili: Kila uniti linapata namba yake ya kumbukumbu. Upeo ni 20 kwa usajili mmoja.

english: A name you recognise, for example Front house or Room A1
swahili: Jina unalolitambua, mfano Nyumba ya mbele au Chumba A1

english: No, mark the ones that do
No, each unit has its own rent
swahili: Hapana, kila uniti na kodi yake

english: Is the rent the same for every unit?
swahili: Je, kodi ni sawa kwa uniti zote?

english: Yes, the rent is the same
The SMS gateway is not connected yet, so the code is shown here for the demo.
swahili: Njia ya SMS haijaunganishwa, kwa hiyo namba inaonyeshwa hapa kwa majaribio.

english: That code is no longer valid. Request a new one.
swahili: Namba hiyo haitumiki tena. Omba nyingine.

english: The code expires in {minutes} minutes and works once.
swahili: Namba inaisha baada ya dakika {minutes} na inatumika mara moja.

english: The code could not be sent. Try again.
No phone number is on your account yet. Use email instead.
swahili: Hakuna namba ya simu kwenye akaunti yako bado. Tumia barua pepe.

english: This confirms it is you before the workspace opens. Your own account still decides what you may see inside it.
swahili: Hii inathibitisha ni wewe kabla eneo la kazi kufunguka. Akaunti yako yenyewe inaamua unachoweza kuona ndani.

english: Too many codes requested. Try again in an hour.
swahili: Namba nyingi zimeombwa. Jaribu baada ya saa moja.

english: This account is registered as {role}. A code opens only the workspace that belongs to the account.
swahili: Akaunti hii imesajiliwa kama {role}. Namba hii inafungua eneo la kazi la akaunti hiyo pekee.

english: We sent a six-digit code to the email on your account: {to}
swahili: Tumetuma namba ya tarakimu sita kwa barua pepe iliyo kwenye akaunti yako: {to}

english: We sent a six-digit code to the phone number on your account: {to}
swahili: Tumetuma namba ya tarakimu sita kwa namba ya simu iliyo kwenye akaunti yako: {to}

english: Codes go only to the phone number or email on your account. Sign in so we know which account to send yours to.
swahili: Namba hutumwa tu kwa simu au barua pepe iliyo kwenye akaunti yako. Ingia ili tujue akaunti ya kutuma namba.
Tuma kwa barua pepe badala yake

english: See registered units, verified ownership and licensed agents in your area. Commissioners get read-only figures.
swahili: Ona vitego vilivyosajiliwa, umiliki uliothibitishwa na mawakala walioidhinishwa katika eneo lako. Makamishna wanapata takwimu za kusoma tu.

english: Landlords can register a unit. Tenants can look for a registered home. Anyone can check a record by its reference.
swahili: Mwenye nyumba anaweza kusajili kitengo. Mpangaji anaweza kutafuta nyumba iliyosajiliwa. Mtu yeyote anaweza kuhakiki kumbukumbu kwa namba yake.

english: This is the interface layer of IBMT. Business records, tax policy and payments are owned by the IBMT backend and are not simulated as complete here.
swahili: Hii ni safu ya kiolesura ya IBMT. Kumbukumbu za biashara, sera ya kodi na malipo vinamilikiwa na backend ya IBMT na havijaiga kukamilika hapa.

english: Find a registered home, keep your lease, record your rent, and hold the record that shows what you paid.
swahili: Pata nyumba iliyosajiliwa, hifadhi mkataba wako, rekodi kodi yako, na uwe na kumbukumbu inayoonyesha ulicholipa.

english: Work inside your own council: registered units, verified ownership, licensed agents and read-only figures.
swahili: Fanya kazi ndani ya halmashauri yako: vitego vilivyosajiliwa, umiliki uliothibitishwa, mawakala walioidhinishwa na takwimu za kusoma tu.

english: Register units, keep tenancies in one place and record the rent you receive.
swahili: Sajili vitego, hifadhi upangaji sehemu moja na rekodi kodi unayopokea.

english: What a record journey looks like
Register your units, keep your tenancies in one place and record the rent you receive. Registration is voluntary at this stage.
swahili: Sajili vitego vyako, hifadhi upangaji wako sehemu moja na rekodi kodi unayopokea. Usajili ni wa hiari katika hatua hii.

english: IBMT Rent is a register of rented homes, leases and rent records for landlords, tenants, licensed agents and councils. The lease exists in writing, and rent is recorded with a receipt that both sides can see.
swahili: IBMT Rent ni daftari la nyumba zinazopangishwa, mikataba na kumbukumbu za kodi kwa wenye nyumba, wapangaji, mawakala walioidhinishwa na halmashauri. Mkataba uko kwa maandishi, na kodi inarekodiwa na risiti ambayo pande zote mbili zinaweza kuiona.

english: Pilot: Kinondoni and Ubungo, Dar es Salaam. Registration is voluntary.
swahili: Awamu ya majaribio: Kinondoni na Ubungo, Dar es Salaam. Usajili ni wa hiari.

english: A register of rented homes: unit registration, ownership verification, written leases, and rent records with a receipt both sides can see.
swahili: Daftari la nyumba zinazopangishwa: usajili wa vitego, uthibitisho wa umiliki, mikataba ya maandishi, na kumbukumbu za kodi zenye risiti ambayo pande zote mbili zinaona.

english: Pilot: Kinondoni and Ubungo, Dar es Salaam. Registration is voluntary.
swahili: Awamu ya majaribio: Kinondoni na Ubungo, Dar es Salaam. Usajili ni wa hiari.

english: The business records what was provided and what was paid.
Amounts are linked to evidence, and labelled by the quality of that evidence.
swahili: Kiasi kinahusishwa na ushahidi, na kinaainishwa kwa ubora wa ushahidi huo.

english: The customer can confirm the record. A rating follows the record, not a rumour.
swahili: Mteja anaweza kuthibitisha kumbukumbu. Kadirio hufuata kumbukumbu, si uvumi.

english: Where something does not add up, an authorised officer reviews it. Nothing is automatic.
swahili: Pale kitu hakilingani, afisa aliyeidhinishwa anakipitia. Hakuna kinachofanyika kiotomatiki.

english: Find a registered home, keep your lease, record your rent, and hold the record that shows what you paid.
swahili: Pata nyumba iliyosajiliwa, hifadhi mkataba wako, rekodi kodi yako, na uwe na kumbukumbu inayoonyesha ulicholipa.

english: Registered Homes. Registered Agents. Rent Receipts.
swahili: Nyumba Zilizosajiliwa. Mawakala Waliosajiliwa. Kodi Yenye Risiti.

english: Check a lease, a rent record or an agent licence by its reference. No personal details are needed to check.
swahili: Hakiki mkataba, kumbukumbu ya kodi au leseni ya wakala kwa namba yake. Hakuna taarifa binafsi inayohitajika kuhakiki.

english: Enter a lease, rent-record or agent-licence reference to see what is publicly confirmable.
swahili: Weka namba ya mkataba, kumbukumbu ya kodi au leseni ya wakala ili kuona kinachoweza kuthibitishwa hadharani.

english: The wording saved when the lease was created. It does not change with the screen language.
swahili: Maneno yaliyohifadhiwa wakati mkataba ulipoundwa. Hayabadiliki kwa lugha ya skrini.

english: The QR page shows only the lease number, unit, ward and dates. No name, address, house number or meter.
swahili: Ukurasa wa QR unaonyesha namba ya mkataba, uniti, kata na tarehe pekee. Hakuna jina, anwani, namba ya nyumba wala mita.

english: Each party signs with their own code.
swahili: Kila upande unasaini kwa namba yake mwenyewe.

english: Give the tenant this code so they can open the lease from their own account. It is removed once used.
swahili: Mpe mpangaji namba hii afungue mkataba kutoka akaunti yake. Namba hii inafutwa mara inapotumika.

english: The lease stays a draft until both parties sign.
swahili: Mkataba unabaki rasimu hadi pande zote mbili zisaini.

english: Once it is opened, each party signs with their own code.
swahili: Ukishafunguliwa, kila upande unasaini kwa namba yake.

english: Give the tenant this code so they can open the lease from their own account:
swahili: Mpe mpangaji namba hii ili afungue mkataba kutoka akaunti yake:

english: The standard terms are filled in for you. You enter the amounts, the period and any house-specific terms.
swahili: Masharti ya kawaida yanajazwa na mfumo. Wewe unajaza kiasi, kipindi na masharti maalum ya nyumba hii.

english: A lease can only be created for a unit whose ownership has been verified. Submit your ownership evidence first.
swahili: Mkataba unaundwa tu kwa uniti ambayo umiliki wake umethibitishwa. Wasilisha ushahidi wa umiliki kwanza.

english: For example: the owner repairs the roof and the water system
swahili: Mfano: mmiliki anarekebisha paa na mfumo wa maji

english: For example: no pets, quiet after 10 pm
swahili: Mfano: hakuna wanyama, utulivu baada ya saa 4 usiku

english: Taken from the standard lease template. The lease document itself is written in Swahili and English.
swahili: Yanatoka kwenye template ya kawaida ya mkataba. Hati ya mkataba yenyewe imeandikwa kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza.

english: Select “Show terms” to read the lease wording before saving.
swahili: Bonyeza “Onyesha masharti” kusoma maneno ya mkataba kabla ya kuhifadhi.

english: This number does not match any lease. Check the number or scan the QR code again.
swahili: Namba hii hailingani na mkataba wowote. Angalia namba au skani QR tena.

english: No name, address, house number or meter number is shown here. The page only confirms that a lease with this number is registered in IBMT Rent.
swahili: Hakuna jina, anwani, namba ya nyumba wala namba ya mita inayoonyeshwa hapa. Ukurasa unathibitisha tu kuwa mkataba wenye namba hii umesajiliwa katika IBMT Rent.

english: This page does not prove ownership
Stamp duty on the lease will be confirmed. No amount is charged here.
swahili: Ushuru wa stempu wa mkataba utathibitishwa. Hakuna kiasi kinachodaiwa hapa.

english: A lease becomes active when both signatures are in.
swahili: Mkataba unakuwa hai pale sahihi zote mbili zinapokuwepo.

english: A standard lease in Swahili and English, signed with each party's own code.
swahili: Mkataba wa kawaida kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza, unaosainiwa kwa namba ya kila upande.

english: Start a lease for a unit verified by an officer. The lease code you give the tenant is what links them to the lease.
swahili: Anza mkataba kwa uniti iliyothibitishwa na afisa. Namba ya mkataba unayompa mpangaji ndiyo inayomuunganisha na mkataba.
Template ya awali, inasubiri ukaguzi wa kisheria

english: the public does not see the address
List a verified unit. The public sees only the ward and mtaa; the address opens after a viewing is booked.
swahili: Tangaza uniti iliyothibitishwa. Umma unaona kata na mtaa pekee; anwani inafunguka baada ya miadi ya kuona.

english: No verified unit is waiting to be listed.
No viewing fee: the tenant pays TZS 0
swahili: Hakuna ada ya kuona: mpangaji analipa TZS 0

english: A unit that is not verified cannot be listed.
The email they used to register with IBMT
Paid by the owner. The tenant pays nothing.
swahili: Hulipwa na mmiliki. Mpangaji halipi chochote.

english: An active mandate gives the agent access to that unit.
swahili: Mamlaka yaliyo hai yanampa wakala ufikiaji wa uniti hiyo.

english: Start by checking the agent's licence.
swahili: Anza kwa kuangalia leseni ya wakala.

english: The owner chooses one licensed agent, a commission within the policy cap, and signs with a code.
swahili: Mmiliki huchagua wakala mmoja mwenye leseni, kamisheni isiyozidi kikomo cha sera, na husaini kwa namba.

english: An agent without a licence cannot be chosen
swahili: Wakala asiye na leseni hawezi kuchaguliwa

english: The council has not confirmed a licence for this account. You may not name this agent.
swahili: Halmashauri haijathibitisha leseni ya akaunti hii. Hauruhusiwi kumtaja wakala huyu.

english: No unit yet. Register a unit first.
swahili: Hakuna uniti bado. Sajili uniti kwanza.

english: terms unchanged · no new lease was prepared.
swahili: masharti hayakubadilishwa · hakuna mkataba mpya ulioandaliwa.

english: The full address is not shown on the certificate; only the ward and mtaa.
swahili: Anwani kamili haionyeshwi kwenye cheti; ni kata na mtaa pekee.

english: The terms stay as they are. The standard lease applies only when this tenancy is renewed.
swahili: Masharti yanabaki kama yalivyo. Mkataba wa kawaida unatumika tu upangaji huu unapohuishwa.

english: Rent, dates and other terms stay as they are. The standard lease comes only at renewal.
swahili: Kodi, tarehe na masharti mengine yanabaki kama yalivyo. Mkataba wa kawaida unakuja tu wakati wa kuhuisha.

english: Enter rent paid, confirm the tenant's records, and issue receipts. This record is not a government tax receipt.
swahili: Andika kodi iliyolipwa, thibitisha kumbukumbu za mpangaji, na toa risiti. Kumbukumbu hii si risiti ya kodi ya serikali.

english: You cannot confirm a record you entered yourself. The receipt is issued when the tenant confirms, and the receipt number is issued at the same time.
swahili: Huwezi kuthibitisha kumbukumbu uliyoiandika mwenyewe. Risiti inatolewa pale mpangaji anapothibitisha, na namba ya risiti inatolewa wakati huohuo.

english: A lease becomes active after both signatures
swahili: Mkataba unakuwa hai baada ya sahihi zote mbili

english: Open a lease with the code your landlord gave you, then sign it with your own code.
swahili: Fungua mkataba kwa namba uliyopewa na mwenye nyumba, kisha usaini kwa namba yako mwenyewe.

english: The lease wording is an early standard template. It is awaiting legal review before use as a formal legal contract.
swahili: Maneno ya mkataba ni template ya kawaida ya awali. Yanasubiri ukaguzi wa kisheria kabla ya kutumika kama mkataba rasmi wa kisheria.

english: Leases where you are the landlord or the tenant.
swahili: Mikataba ambayo wewe ni mwenye nyumba au mpangaji.

english: No lease has been opened yet.
The lease code comes from the landlord or agent.
swahili: Namba ya mkataba inatoka kwa mwenye nyumba au wakala.

english: Business record — not a fiscal EFD/VFD receipt.
swahili: Kumbukumbu ya biashara — si risiti ya kifiskali ya EFD/VFD.

english: Policy values are shown from the backend and carry a version.
swahili: Viwango vya sera vinaonyeshwa kutoka backend na vina toleo.

english: This record changed after you opened it.
swahili: Kumbukumbu hii ilibadilika baada ya wewe kuifungua.

english: A NIDA number has 20 digits. Make sure you wrote them all.
swahili: Namba ya NIDA ina tarakimu 20. Hakikisha umeandika tarakimu zote.

english: Choose a unit, then write the tenant's name and phone number.
swahili: Chagua uniti, kisha andika jina na namba ya simu ya mpangaji.

english: The link for capturing an incoming tenant's details for one unit. No lease is created here.
swahili: Kiungo cha kukusanya taarifa za mpangaji anayeingia kwa uniti moja. Hakuna mkataba unaoundwa hapa.

english: Use this link to enter the details of an incoming tenant.
swahili: Tumia kiungo hiki kuingiza taarifa za mpangaji anayeingia.

english: 20 digits from the tenant's NIDA card
swahili: Tarakimu 20 kutoka kitambulisho cha NIDA cha mpangaji

english: When the tenant moves in, how many people
swahili: Mpangaji anaingia lini, ana watu wangapi

english: The registration notice is sent to this number
swahili: Taarifa ya usajili inatumwa kwa namba hii

english: Details already entered through this link.
swahili: Taarifa zilizokwisha kuingizwa kupitia kiungo hiki.

english: Save and send the tenant a notice
Details they filled in themselves through the link you gave them.
swahili: Taarifa walizojaza wenyewe kupitia kiungo ulichowapa.

english: The notice was sent to the tenant's phone.
swahili: Taarifa imetumwa kwa simu ya mpangaji.

english: The message is prepared and saved. No SMS service is connected, so nothing has left the system. It will be sent once an SMS service is set up.
swahili: Ujumbe umeandaliwa na kuhifadhiwa. Huduma ya SMS haijaunganishwa, kwa hiyo hakuna ujumbe uliotoka kwenye mfumo. Utatumwa mara huduma ya SMS itakapowekwa.

english: The tenant will still sign a lease with the landlord. Here we only record the details and send them a registration notice.
swahili: Mpangaji bado atasaini mkataba na mwenye nyumba. Hapa tunarekodi taarifa tu, na kumtumia taarifa ya usajili.

english: Fill in the details of the tenant moving into the unit.
swahili: Jaza taarifa za mpangaji anayeingia kwenye uniti.

english: Exact home addresses and GPS coordinates never appear on public pages, public responses, analytics or public document links.
swahili: Anwani kamili za nyumbani na viwianishi vya GPS hazionekani kwenye kurasa za umma, majibu ya umma, uchanganuzi au viungo vya nyaraka za umma.

english: Each unit links privately to an Anwani ya Makazi address and TANESCO meter evidence.
swahili: Kila kitengo kinahusiana kwa faragha na anwani ya Anwani ya Makazi na ushahidi wa mita ya TANESCO.

english: Eligible agent commission, from the landlord's share
swahili: Kamisheni inayostahili ya wakala, kutoka sehemu ya mwenye nyumba

english: Allocation of the payment, as provided by the backend
swahili: Mgawanyo wa malipo, kama ulivyotolewa na backend

english: Assisted onboarding is available for operators and landlords.
swahili: Usajili wa kusaidiwa unapatikana kwa wafanyabiashara na wenye nyumba.

english: A completed condition checklist is not deposit release.
swahili: Orodha ya hali iliyokamilika si kutolewa kwa amana.

english: Commission is capped, funded by the landlord, and charged once per new tenancy — never on renewal.
swahili: Kamisheni ina kikomo, inalipwa na mwenye nyumba, na inatozwa mara moja kwa upangaji mpya — kamwe si kwa kuongeza muda.

english: Committee records are never exposed to TRA.
swahili: Kumbukumbu za kamati hazionyeshwi kwa TRA kamwe.

english: Deposit custody is separate and held in the tenant's name.
swahili: Amana inashikiliwa kivyake, kwa jina la mpangaji.

english: Expenses are labelled by the quality of evidence held. IBMT does not decide deductibility.
swahili: Matumizi yanaainishwa kwa ubora wa ushahidi uliopo. IBMT haiamui kupunguza kodi.

english: Fiscal status confirmed for this receipt by the backend.
swahili: Hali ya kifiskali imethibitishwa kwa risiti hii na backend.

english: Committee contributions are gifts. They are excluded from business turnover and from every TRA view.
swahili: Michango ya kamati ni zawadi. Haitahesabiwa kwenye mauzo ya biashara wala kwenye maoni yoyote ya TRA.

english: An address or meter mismatch, or unusually low rent, creates a human-review notice only. No automatic fine, informant reward, scraping or allegation is created.
swahili: Kutolingana kwa anwani au mita, au kodi ndogo isiyo ya kawaida, huunda notisi ya mapitio ya mtu pekee. Hakuna faini ya kiotomatiki, zawadi ya mtoa taarifa, uchoraji wa taarifa au shtaka linaloundwa.

english: IBMT never holds rent. The money passes directly between tenant and landlord; IBMT records it.
swahili: IBMT haishikilii kodi. Fedha zinapita moja kwa moja kati ya mpangaji na mwenye nyumba; IBMT inairekodi.

english: Only council-licensed agents registered as IBMT businesses can be selected on a mandate.
swahili: Ni mawakala walioidhinishwa na halmashauri na waliosajiliwa kama biashara za IBMT pekee wanaoweza kuchaguliwa kwenye wakala wa mali.

english: The low-rent exemption threshold is defined by TRA in backend policy.
swahili: Kiwango cha kutotozwa kodi kwa kodi ndogo kinaainishwa na TRA kwenye sera ya backend.

english: Existing tenancies migrate without forced renegotiation. Paid-through evidence is preserved.
swahili: Upangaji uliopo unahamia bila kulazimishwa kufanya mkataba mpya. Ushahidi wa malipo uliofanyika unahifadhiwa.

english: Nothing here is an enforcement action. Human review comes before any decision.
swahili: Hakuna kitendo cha utekelezaji hapa. Mapitio ya mtu yanatangulia uamuzi wowote.

english: IBMT never holds rent. In this stage IBMT only records the payment; the money passes directly between tenant and landlord.
swahili: IBMT haishikilii kodi. Katika hatua hii IBMT inarekodi malipo tu; fedha zinapita moja kwa moja kati ya mpangaji na mwenye nyumba.

english: No social-media surveillance and no automatic tip-off to TRA.
swahili: Hakuna ufuatiliaji wa mitandao ya kijamii na hakuna taarifa ya kiotomatiki kwa TRA.

english: No tax is deducted in this stage. Nothing recorded here is tax revenue, and no certificate of tax compliance is issued.
swahili: Hakuna kodi inayozuiwa katika hatua hii. Hakuna kinachorekodiwa hapa kilicho mapato ya kodi, na hakuna cheti cha kufuata sheria za kodi kinachotolewa.

english: No tenant platform fee, agent fee or viewing fee.
swahili: Hakuna ada ya jukwaa kwa mpangaji, ada ya wakala au ada ya kuona nyumba.

english: One tenancy relates to one unit and one active lease.
swahili: Upangaji mmoja unahusiana na kitengo kimoja na mkataba mmoja unaoendelea.

english: A unit cannot receive rent until ownership evidence is verified by the authorised officer.
swahili: Kitengo hakiwezi kupokea kodi mpaka ushahidi wa umiliki uthibitishwe na afisa aliyeidhinishwa.

english: Council permit fees are separate from TRA tax and are not collected as tax.
swahili: Ada za vibali za halmashauri ni tofauti na kodi ya TRA, na hazikusanywi kama kodi.

english: Tax rates, stamp duty, commission caps, exemption thresholds, advance-rent limits and response windows are versioned backend policy values. They are displayed from the backend and never hard-coded here.
swahili: Viwango vya kodi, ushuru wa stempu, kikomo cha kamisheni, kiwango cha kutotozwa kodi, kikomo cha kodi ya mapema na muda wa kujibu ni sera zinazobadilika kwa matoleo kwenye backend. Zinaonyeshwa kutoka backend na hazijaandikwa moja kwa moja hapa.

english: Proxy registration is permitted with evidence of authority.
swahili: Usajili kwa mwakilishi unaruhusiwa ukiwa na ushahidi wa mamlaka.

english: Business record — not a fiscal EFD/VFD receipt.
swahili: Kumbukumbu ya biashara — si risiti ya kifiskali ya EFD/VFD.

english: Unit registration is voluntary in Kinondoni and Ubungo. No by-law is in force for this pilot, so no penalty applies and nothing is treated as overdue.
swahili: Usajili wa vitego ni wa hiari katika Kinondoni na Ubungo. Hakuna sheria ndogo inayotumika kwa majaribio haya, hivyo hakuna adhabu na hakuna kinachochukuliwa kama kimechelewa.

english: A registration window is shown only where a confirmed by-law sets one. While the council's mode is voluntary, no window and no penalty applies.
swahili: Kipindi cha usajili kinaonyeshwa tu pale sheria ndogo iliyothibitishwa inakiweka. Wakati hali ya halmashauri ni ya hiari, hakuna kipindi na hakuna adhabu.

english: Retention periods are shown as supplied by the backend. This interface does not state a statutory period.
swahili: Muda wa kuhifadhi unaonyeshwa kama ulivyotolewa na backend. Kiolesura hiki hakitoi muda wa kisheria.

english: Tenant details are shown to TRA only in the approved backend projection.
swahili: Maelezo ya mpangaji yanaonyeshwa kwa TRA kwa kiwango kilichoidhinishwa na backend pekee.

english: The tenant pays rent plus the applicable initial deposit, and nothing else.
swahili: Mpangaji analipa kodi pamoja na amana ya awali inayohitajika, na hakuna kingine.

english: Business turnover recorded here is not government tax revenue.
swahili: Mauzo ya biashara yanayorekodiwa hapa si Mapato ya kodi ya serikali.

english: The compliance entity is the individual unit.
swahili: Kitu cha kufuata sheria ni kitengo binafsi cha nyumba.

english: Tax withholding is designed but switched off. No tax is deducted anywhere in this stage, and the machinery stays dormant.
swahili: Mfumo wa kuzuia kodi umeundwa lakini umezimwa. Hakuna kodi inayozuiwa mahali popote katika hatua hii, na mfumo unabaki tulivu.

english: No rent arrears in recent periods.
swahili: Hakuna deni la kodi kwa vipindi vya karibuni.

english: With SMS on, a reminder is sent as a text message. Otherwise it stays inside the app.
swahili: Ukiwasha SMS, kikumbusho kinatumwa kama ujumbe mfupi. Vinginevyo kinabaki ndani ya app.

english: waiting for the other party to confirm. No receipt yet.
swahili: inasubiri uthibitisho wa upande wa pili. Hakuna risiti bado.

english: Optional. A deposit is not rent.
A rent record needs an active tenancy. When a lease starts, the tenancy is created and appears here.
swahili: Kumbukumbu ya kodi inahitaji upangaji ulio hai. Mkataba unapoanza, upangaji unaundwa na unaonekana hapa.

english: The mobile money or bank reference as written
swahili: Namba ya pesa kwa simu au ya benki kama ilivyoandikwa

english: For example: wrong amount, reference not found
swahili: Mfano: kiasi si sahihi, kumbukumbu haipo

english: Waiting for the other party to confirm.
The full address and meter number are not shown to the public. Only the Mtaa officer can see them.
swahili: Anwani kamili na namba ya mita hazionyeshwi kwa umma. Zinaonekana kwa afisa wa Mtaa pekee.

english: You fill in the form; the owner confirms with a code on their own phone. We cannot approve a registration on their behalf.
swahili: Wewe unajaza; mmiliki anathibitisha kwa namba kwenye simu yake. Hatuwezi kuidhinisha usajili kwa niaba yake.

english: The code is sent to the owner's phone. The helper does not get it and cannot approve on their own.
swahili: Namba inatumwa kwa simu ya mmiliki. Msaidizi haipati na hawezi kuidhinisha mwenyewe.

english: An approved agent can register on your behalf; you confirm with a code.
swahili: Wakala aliyeidhinishwa anaweza kusajili kwa niaba yako; wewe unathibitisha kwa namba.

english: The details go to the Mtaa officer for your area. Registration confirms that the house is registered, not that you are its owner.
swahili: Taarifa zinaenda kwa afisa wa Mtaa wa eneo lako. Usajili unathibitisha kuwa nyumba imesajiliwa, si kwamba wewe ndiye mmiliki.

english: If you are acting for an owner who is far away or has died, use the representative route and attach a confirmation letter.
swahili: Kama unafanya hivi kwa niaba ya mmiliki aliye mbali au aliyefariki, tumia njia ya mwakilishi na uweke barua ya uthibitisho.

english: If the house has a tenant now, do not start a new lease. Enter the existing details; the terms stay as they are.
swahili: Kama nyumba ina mpangaji sasa, usianzishe mkataba mpya. Ingiza taarifa zilizopo; masharti yanabaki kama yalivyo.

english: The tenant confirms with a code.
A house you already rent out
Register a house and its rooms

swahili: Inatozwa mara moja kwa upangaji mpya
Kamisheni ya kuongeza muda ni sifuri
Foleni ya mapitio ya kufuata sheria
Namba ya siri ya mara moja ya pande zote

english: Review the terms in both languages before signing
swahili: Pitia masharti kwa lugha zote mbili kabla ya kusaini

english: These four statuses are separate. A calculated split is not a completed remittance.
swahili: Hali hizi nne ni tofauti. Mgawanyo uliohesabiwa si uwasilishaji uliokamilika.

english: One party enters a record; the other confirms it. The receipt is issued after confirmation.
swahili: Upande mmoja unaingiza kumbukumbu; upande wa pili unaithibitisha. Risiti inatolewa baada ya uthibitisho.

english: Each record has its own status. A receipt is issued once it is confirmed.
swahili: Kila kumbukumbu ina hali yake. Risiti inatolewa uthibitisho unapofanyika.

english: 7 days and 1 day before rent is due
swahili: Siku 7 na siku 1 kabla kodi haijafika

english: Demonstration role switch — available in demonstration mode only
swahili: Kubadilisha wajibu ni kwa majaribio tu

english: In API mode the role and jurisdiction come from the IBMT session.
swahili: Kwenye hali ya API, wajibu na eneo la mamlaka vinatoka kwenye kipindi cha IBMT.
Anwani ya msingi ya API ya IBMT

english: Runtime setting. The backend's approved session mechanism carries authority, not this value.
swahili: Mpangilio wa wakati wa kutumia. Mamlaka yanatokana na mfumo wa kipindi ulioidhinishwa na backend, si thamani hii.

english: Your own records, stored and validated by the IBMT platform backend. Offline writes sync automatically.
swahili: Kumbukumbu zako mwenyewe, zinazohifadhiwa na kuthibitishwa na backend ya IBMT. Mabadiliko ya nje ya mtandao hurudi kiotomatiki.

english: Identity comes from the IBMT backend. This interface keeps only presentation preferences, and never credentials.
swahili: Utambulisho unatoka kwenye backend ya IBMT. Kiolesura hiki kinahifadhi mapendeleo ya muonekano pekee, na hakuna nywila.

english: Not signed in through IBMT yet
Send each tenant the link for their unit. They fill it in themselves and the details come to you.
swahili: Mtumie kila mpangaji kiungo cha uniti yake. Yeye hujaza mwenyewe, na taarifa zinakuja kwako.

english: Full name, NIDA number, the rent they pay, and whether they paid a broker. Their answer is saved even if they did not.
swahili: Jina kamili, namba ya NIDA, kodi anayolipa, na kama alimlipa dalali. Hata kama hakulipa, jibu linahifadhiwa.

english: Someone else updated this record after you opened it. Reload to see the current version before deciding.
swahili: Mtu mwingine amesasisha kumbukumbu hii baada ya wewe kuifungua. Pakia tena kuona hali ya sasa kabla ya kuamua.
Hakuna kumbukumbu inayolingana na mwonekano huu.

english: The request did not complete. Nothing was changed. You can try again safely.
swahili: Ombi halikukamilika. Hakuna kilichobadilishwa. Unaweza kujaribu tena salama.

english: Retrieving this view from the integration layer.
swahili: Inachukua maelezo kutoka safu ya muunganisho.

english: This screen is not wired to live records in this build. Nothing was changed, and no sample data is shown in its place.
swahili: Skrini hii bado haijaunganishwa na taarifa halisi katika toleo hili. Hakuna kilichobadilishwa, na hakuna data ya mfano inayoonyeshwa badala yake.

english: Changes cannot be sent while the connection is down. Nothing was submitted.
swahili: Mabadiliko hayawezi kutumwa wakati mtandao umekatika. Hakuna kilichowasilishwa.

english: Your role or jurisdiction cannot open this record. The backend enforces this, not the interface.
swahili: Wajibu wako au eneo lako la mamlaka haviwezi kufungua kumbukumbu hii. Backend ndiyo inayolinda hili, si kiolesura.

english: Saved on this device. It will be submitted automatically, unchanged, when the connection returns.
swahili: Imehifadhiwa kwenye kifaa hiki. Itawasilishwa kiotomatiki, bila kubadilika, mtandao ukirudi.

english: Sign in again through the IBMT session to continue. No action was recorded.
swahili: Ingia tena kupitia kipindi cha IBMT ili kuendelea. Hakuna kitendo kilichorekodiwa.

english: Tax estimated from confirmed rent records. This is not a tax assessment or a payment.
swahili: Kodi inayokadiriwa kutoka kwenye kumbukumbu za kodi zilizothibitishwa. Hii si tathmini ya kodi wala malipo.

english: No tax rule has been set yet, so no amount is shown.
swahili: Hakuna kanuni ya kodi iliyowekwa bado, kwa hiyo hakuna kiasi kinachoonyeshwa.

english: Did you pay a broker when you moved in?
You wrote these details yourself. A lease signed with the landlord is still needed.
swahili: Taarifa hizi umeziandika wewe mwenyewe. Mkataba uliosainiwa na mwenye nyumba bado unahitajika.

english: What you send is your own statement
Write the amount you paid the broker.
Choose whether you paid a broker or not.
swahili: Chagua kama ulimlipa dalali au hukumlipa.

english: Write the rent you pay each month.
You wrote that you did not pay a broker. This answer is saved in the record.
swahili: Uliandika kuwa hukumlipa dalali. Jibu hili limehifadhiwa kwenye kumbukumbu.

english: You wrote that you paid a broker {amount} TZS.
Your details go only to the landlord and the council. The NIDA number is not shown publicly.
swahili: Taarifa zako zinaenda kwa mwenye nyumba na halmashauri pekee. Namba ya NIDA haionyeshwi hadharani.

english: The landlord and the council see the details you sent. Your NIDA number is not shown publicly.
swahili: Mwenye nyumba na halmashauri wanaona taarifa ulizotuma. Namba yako ya NIDA haionyeshwi hadharani.

english: Fill in your details and what you pay.
swahili: Jaza taarifa zako na kiasi unacholipa.
Namba ya siri ya mara moja

english: The rent service on a basic phone, without internet or a smartphone.
swahili: Huduma ya kodi kwenye simu ya kawaida, bila intaneti au simu janja.

english: Simulated keypad with demonstration data. Real USSD responses come from the backend.
swahili: Kibodi ya mfano yenye data ya majaribio. Majibu ya kweli ya USSD yanatoka backend.

english: Session state is local to this simulator only.
swahili: Hali ya kipindi ni ya simulator hii pekee.

english: Simulation — demonstration only. No real USSD session runs and no money moves.
swahili: Simulizi — kwa majaribio tu. Hakuna kipindi halisi cha USSD na hakuna fedha zinazohamia.

english: Public verification answers one question: is this record real, and what does it confirm?
swahili: Uthibitisho wa umma unajibu swali moja: kumbukumbu hii ni ya kweli, na inathibitisha nini?

english: No public record matches that reference
swahili: Hakuna kumbukumbu ya umma inayolingana na namba hiyo

english: Check the reference. A record may exist but not be public, and unpublished records are never confirmed or denied here.
swahili: Angalia namba. Kumbukumbu inaweza kuwepo lakini isiwe ya umma, na kumbukumbu zisizochapishwa hazithibitishwi wala kukataliwa hapa.

english: Do not enter personal data. A reference alone is enough.
swahili: Usiweke maelezo binafsi. Namba ya kumbukumbu inatosha.

english: A public check confirms existence, status and the amounts already public on the document you are holding. It never reveals addresses, GPS coordinates or personal details.
swahili: Uthibitisho wa umma unathibitisha kuwepo, hali na kiasi kilicho hadharani kwenye hati uliyonayo. Haionyeshi anwani, viwianishi vya GPS au maelezo binafsi.

english: Repeated lookups of references you do not hold may be restricted by the backend.
swahili: Kuangalia mara kwa mara namba usizozimiliki kunaweza kuzuiwa na backend.
Namba ya mkataba au namba ya QR

english: Check a lease, a receipt, an agent licence or a unit registration. You get the status only: no name, address or phone number.
swahili: Angalia mkataba, risiti, leseni ya wakala au usajili wa uniti. Unapata hali pekee: hakuna jina, anwani wala namba ya simu.

english: No agent licence matches that number. Check the number or scan the QR code again.
swahili: Hakuna leseni ya wakala inayolingana na namba hiyo. Angalia namba au skani QR tena.

english: No lease matches that number. Check the number or scan the QR code again.
swahili: Hakuna mkataba unaolingana na namba hiyo. Angalia namba au skani QR tena.

english: No receipt matches that number. Check the number or scan the QR code again.
swahili: Hakuna risiti inayolingana na namba hiyo. Angalia namba au skani QR tena.

english: No unit registration matches that number. Check the number or scan the QR code again.
swahili: Hakuna usajili wa uniti unaolingana na namba hiyo. Angalia namba au skani QR tena.

english: Checks are rate-limited to prevent scraping of records.
swahili: Ukaguzi umepunguzwa kasi kuzuia uvunaji wa kumbukumbu.

english: Decision saved; the owner will see your reason.
swahili: Uamuzi umehifadhiwa; mmiliki ataona sababu yako.

english: Another unit in this ward has the same address or meter. Review both records; this is not a rejection.
swahili: Uniti nyingine katika kata hii ina anwani au mita ileile. Kagua kumbukumbu zote mbili; huku si kukataliwa.

english: New registrations in your area appear here.
swahili: Usajili mpya wa eneo lako utaonekana hapa.

english: Review each registration in your area. Every decision needs a reason, and the owner sees it.
swahili: Kagua kila usajili wa eneo lako. Kila uamuzi unahitaji sababu, na mmiliki anaiona.

english: Reason — the owner will see it (at least 10 characters)
Another unit in this ward has the same address or meter. Registration is not blocked and not rejected: the Mtaa officer reviews both records.
swahili: Uniti nyingine katika kata hii ina anwani au mita ileile. Usajili haujazuiwa wala kukataliwa: afisa wa Mtaa anakagua kumbukumbu zote mbili.

english: This has been sent to the Mtaa officer
swahili: Taarifa hii imetumwa kwa afisa wa Mtaa

english: At least one document is required. Documents are stored privately.
swahili: Angalau hati moja inahitajika. Nyaraka zinahifadhiwa kwa faragha.

english: The landlord received a code on their own phone. The helper does not see it.
swahili: Mwenye nyumba amepokea namba kwenye simu yake mwenyewe. Msaidizi haioni.

english: The confirmation code is sent here
Unit {unit} · waiting for the Mtaa officer. No proof of ownership is issued here.
swahili: Uniti {unit} · inasubiri afisa wa Mtaa. Hakuna uthibitisho wa umiliki unaotolewa hapa.

english: The document could not be uploaded.
